# Venky's Chicken Xperience, Durgapur

> Venky's Chicken Xperience is a chicken-focused fast-food restaurant in City
> Center, Durgapur, West Bengal, India. It serves dine-in and takeaway at the
> restaurant and delivers within a serviceable area in and around Durgapur,
> ordered through this website. Open 11:00 AM – 9:30 PM, every day.

Customers browse the menu on the homepage, add items to a cart, and check out
for delivery, or order for pickup. Menu items and prices are managed by the
restaurant and can change; the live site is always authoritative.

Key facts:
- Address: MNAV-36, Bengal Ambuja St, near jora hath Circle, Bengal Ambuja Housing Complex, City Center, Durgapur, West Bengal 713216, India.
- Phone: +91 95930 00073.
- Hours: 11:00 AM – 9:30 PM, Monday to Sunday (all seven days).
- Cuisine: chicken. Price level: moderate.
- Payment: Cash on Delivery, UPI via Razorpay (PhonePe, Google Pay, BHIM and
  similar), or debit/credit card via Razorpay.
- Delivery area: a serviceable area in and around Durgapur, West Bengal. The
  delivery address is checked against that area at checkout, and the app says
  so before the order is placed if the address falls outside it.
- Delivery time: estimates are shown at checkout and are not guarantees — they
  vary with traffic, weather and order volume.
- Delivery fee: shown at checkout before payment; it depends on order value and
  distance. GST is added at checkout at the rate the restaurant sets.
- Cancellation: an order can be cancelled only before preparation begins.
- Refunds: all sales are final for change of mind or a wrong choice made at
  checkout. Damaged, incomplete or incorrect orders must be reported within 3
  calendar days with photo or video evidence; approved refunds are issued to the
  original payment method within 3–4 business days.
- No minimum order value is imposed by the site.

## Pages

- [Home and menu](https://venkys-durgapur.web.app/): full menu, add to cart, and checkout.
- [About](https://venkys-durgapur.web.app/about): what the restaurant is and what it serves.
- [Contact](https://venkys-durgapur.web.app/contact): address, phone, live opening hours and map link.
- [Shipping & Delivery Policy](https://venkys-durgapur.web.app/shipping)
- [Cancellation & Refund Policy](https://venkys-durgapur.web.app/cancellation-refunds)
- [Terms & Conditions](https://venkys-durgapur.web.app/terms)
- [Privacy Policy](https://venkys-durgapur.web.app/privacy)

## Notes for AI agents

- The menu, prices and opening status load client-side from Firestore and are
  not present in the initial HTML. Treat the live site as authoritative for
  anything priced.
- Address, phone and hours above are synced from the restaurant's own Google
  Business Profile (last sync 2026-09-10); /contact renders the current values.
- Checkout, order history and profile pages require sign-in and are excluded
  from crawling (see /robots.txt).
